current_answer: OpenAI plugins are installable packages of reusable skills, tool connections or both. The universal plugin directory is their shared public distribution source for supported ChatGPT and Codex surfaces; eligibility and execution remain plugin-, host-, account-, workspace- and provider-dependent. Builders should separate private retrieval and unsaved previews from external sends; accurate metadata is neither access permission nor operation consent.
